prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Turn this EXACT orthographic blockout into a finished painted miniature game sprite sheet. This is a camera-calibration asset, so match the supplied geometry rather than composing a new view.
PRESERVE the original image layout, every object's silhouette and size, hull axis slopes, relative foreshortening and three-dimensional position. Keep objects where they are. Match the low camera in the input exactly; do NOT make the view more top-down. North/south hulls are only about half the length of east/west hulls; do NOT enlarge them to fill their cells. A visible upright cabin adds its natural height to the hull.
Finish the blockout with this identity: Teal-blue passenger ferry hull, cream cabin, orange wooden benches on the stern deck, teal funnel with black rim, ivory handrails, tiny orange lifebuoys. Cabin windows dark teal, fine hull rivets, weathered deck planks. Rounded aft corners but sharp forward bow as in guide.
Use realistic textured metal, wood, windows and crisp restrained highlights, high-quality hand-painted Transport Tycoon-style art, no thick cartoon outlines. Fine texture should sit on the surfaces already in the guide. Fixed upper-left sunlight.
The exact 3×3 cell order is NW,N,NE / W,EMPTY,E / SW,S,SE. Orange dots indicate the FRONT pointed bow; replace each dot with natural bow detail. N points up, S points down. Remove all labels, dots and every blueprint/guide mark. Retain the complete empty transparent center cell, generous transparent spacing and the same physical scale across views. Background must be true alpha transparency. No water, wake, ground tile, cast shadows, text, frames or extra objects. Output a square sheet.
